name: Ollama Chat Model
category_description: AI cluster sub-node (model, memory, tool, parser)
description: The Ollama Chat Model node allows you use local Llama 2 models with conversational agents[^1]

parameters.name: Model
parameters.description: Select the model that generates the completion. Choose from:

parameters.name: Sampling Temperature
parameters.description: Use this option to control the randomness of the sampling process. A higher temperature creates more diverse sampling, but increases the risk of hallucinations

parameters.name: Top K
parameters.description: Enter the number of token choices the model uses to generate the next token

parameters.name: Top P
parameters.description: Use this option to set the probability the completion should use. Use a lower value to ignore less probable options

common_issues.title: Processing parameters
common_issues.summary: The Ollama Chat Model node is a sub-node[^1]. Sub-nodes behave differently than other nodes when processing multiple items using expressions

common_issues.title: Can't connect to a remote Ollama instance
common_issues.summary: The Ollama Chat Model node supports Bearer token authentication for connecting to remote Ollama instances behind authenticated proxies (such as Open WebUI)

common_issues.title: Can't connect to a local Ollama instance when using Docker
common_issues.summary: The Ollama Chat Model node connects to a locally hosted Ollama instance using the base URL defined by Ollama credentials. When you run either n8n or Ollama in Docker, you need to configure the network so that n8n can connect to Ollama

common_issues.title: Error: connect ECONNREFUSED ::1:11434
common_issues.summary: This error occurs when your computer has IPv6 enabled, but Ollama is listening to an IPv4 address

common_issues.title: Ollama and HTTP/HTTPS proxies
common_issues.summary: Ollama doesn't support custom HTTP agents in its configuration. This makes it difficult to use Ollama behind custom HTTP/HTTPS proxies. Depending on your proxy configuration, it might not work at all, despite setting the HTTP_PROXY or HTTPS_PROXY environment variables

parameters.name: notice
parameters.displayName: This node must be connected to an AI chain. Insert one

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: The model which will generate the completion. To download models, visit Ollama Models Library.

options.name: think
options.description: Whether to enable (default) thinking mode for supported models. When enabled, the model's thinking process is separated from the output. When disabled, the mode

options.name: temperature
options.description: Controls the randomness of the generated text. Lower values make the output more focused and deterministic, while higher values make it more diverse and random.

options.name: topK
options.description: Limits the number of highest probability vocabulary tokens to consider at each step. A higher value increases diversity but may reduce coherence. Set to -1 to d

options.name: topP
options.description: Chooses from the smallest possible set of tokens whose cumulative probability exceeds the probability top_p. Helps generate more human-like text by reducing rep

options.name: frequencyPenalty
options.description: Adjusts the penalty for tokens that have already appeared in the generated text. Higher values discourage repetition.

options.name: keepAlive
options.description: Specifies the duration to keep the loaded model in memory after use. Useful for frequently used models. Format: 1h30m (1 hour 30 minutes).

options.name: lowVram
options.description: Whether to Activate low VRAM mode, which reduces memory usage at the cost of slower generation speed. Useful for GPUs with limited memory.

options.name: mainGpu
options.description: Specifies the ID of the GPU to use for the main computation. Only change this if you have multiple GPUs.

options.name: numBatch
options.description: Sets the batch size for prompt processing. Larger batch sizes may improve generation speed but increase memory usage.

options.name: numCtx
options.description: The maximum number of tokens to use as context for generating the next token. Smaller values reduce memory usage, while larger values provide more context to th

options.name: numGpu
options.description: Specifies the number of GPUs to use for parallel processing. Set to -1 for auto-detection.

options.name: numPredict
options.description: The maximum number of tokens to generate. Set to -1 for no limit. Be cautious when setting this to a large value, as it can lead to very long outputs.

options.name: numThread
options.description: Specifies the number of CPU threads to use for processing. Set to 0 for auto-detection.

options.name: penalizeNewline
options.description: Whether the model will be less likely to generate newline characters, encouraging longer continuous sequences of text

options.name: presencePenalty
options.description: Adjusts the penalty for tokens based on their presence in the generated text so far. Positive values penalize tokens that have already appeared, encouraging div

options.name: repeatPenalty
options.description: Adjusts the penalty factor for repeated tokens. Higher values more strongly discourage repetition. Set to 1.0 to disable repetition penalty.

options.name: useMLock
options.description: Whether to lock the model in memory to prevent swapping. This can improve performance but requires sufficient available memory.

options.name: useMMap
options.description: Whether to use memory mapping for loading the model. This can reduce memory usage but may impact performance. Recommended to keep enabled.

options.name: vocabOnly
options.description: Whether to only load the model vocabulary without the weights. Useful for quickly testing tokenization.

options.name: format
options.description: Specifies the format of the API response
